title: BREAKING: Jessalyn Garza arrested on felony drug charge
excerpt: Jessalyn Janeth Garza was booked into the Webb County Jail on Oct. 24 on an alleged third-degree felony charge of possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 2, 1 gram to 4 grams. Bond was not set.
content:
LAREDO — An 18-year-old woman was booked into the Webb County Jail early Saturday morning on an alleged felony drug charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Jessalyn Janeth Garza was arrested on October 24, 2026, at 4:20 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department. The booking record lists possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 2, 1 gram to 4 grams — a third-degree felony. Bond was not set.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
